sanitization_steps: Run python3 -B scripts/zap-fixture.py sanitize ORIGINAL OUTPUT to reproduce the derivative from the private original.
Replace each URI query value with the literal redacted. Preserve query names, order, duplicates and bare names.
Remove each instance nodeName, which can repeat the unsanitized URL.
Replace nonempty attack, evidence and otherinfo strings with [redacted]. Preserve empty fields and array order.
Preserve site identity, alert and instance positions, scanner codes, method, path and parameter identity. Serialize as UTF-8 JSON.
